rows.text: The Secretary-General lays on the Table of the Rajya Sabha on 7 March 1991, as papers 'received by me from the Secretary to the President', a copy of a letter dated 6 March 1991 from the Prime Minister (Chandra Shekhar) to the President tendering his own resignation and that of his Council of Ministers (LT-2215/91).

locator.item: Papers laid on the Table, paper I

rows.text: Paper II laid the same day is a copy of a letter dated 6 March 1991 from the President to the Prime Minister (Chandra Shekhar) accepting his resignation and the resignation of his colleagues from the Council of Ministers (LT-2216/91).

locator.item: Papers laid on the Table, paper II

rows.text: The same letter is described as 'requesting them to continue in Office till a new Government is formed', them being the Prime Minister (Chandra Shekhar) and his colleagues.

locator.item: Papers laid on the Table, paper II: 'requesting them to continue in Office till a new Government is formed'

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-11 only.
